title: The 2025 rate cuts: how the RBI went from 6.50% to 5.25%, and why it's reversing
short: 2025's rate cuts: 6.50% to 5.25%, and why they're reversing
dek: Four cuts worth 125 basis points as inflation fell to record lows. Ten months later, the RBI was hiking again. The full round trip.
card: 125 basis points of cuts in 2025 as inflation collapsed. By October 2026, the RBI had started hiking again.
